# Best Practices Checks

All the checks done by [Best Practices Validation](best_practices.md), with the ID found in their message.
`{}` is a value that is only known when the message is printed.

Vendor specific checks are only done when the vendor is enabled in the settings, their message starts with the vendor tag (such as `[Arm]`).
